At Dhul-Hulaifa the Prophet overturned pots of hastily cooked booty, counted a camel as ten sheep, and allowed slaughter with what spills blood, but not teeth or nails.
Pots cooked before the booty's division are overturned; ten sheep count as a camel; a runaway camel may be shot; and any blood-letting tool but tooth or nail may slaughter.
Any blood-letting tool may slaughter, with Allah's name, except tooth or nail, and a runaway camel may be shot; Zaid bin Amr refused meat slaughtered on stone altars.
A dying sheep slaughtered with a stone was allowed; any blood-letting tool serves except tooth or nail; meat from recent converts is eaten with Allah's name said over it.
Facing battle without knives, they were told any blood-letting tool serves except tooth or nail and a runaway camel may be shot; Asma's people slaughtered a horse and ate it.
Without knives, slaughter with anything that makes blood flow, naming Allah, but not tooth or nail; a camel bolting like a wild beast may be stopped with an arrow.
